verdicts.decision_note: First target-specific claim that the badge visual-design artifacts had been produced for review.
The client unambiguously approves using all presented badge designs in the product UI.
The client changes the rendered badge catalog by replacing First Mint, retaining the sapling icon, and requiring distinct icons; removing the stale all-presented-badges key is replay-consistent.
The client establishes a concrete catalog-membership acceptance choice: add a tenth badge or remove Legend to complete the rows.
Target-specific implementation claim that the later catalog change is live with eight badges and Legend removed.
The client accepts the implemented eight-badge catalog without Legend; the obsolete alternative-options key exists before this Event and is correctly removed.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
1 - The invalid-code message looks great, but it needs one final wording change to: 'No/Invalid referral code! $5 + $500 prize draw ticket will go to an existing NFT holder at random'.

2 - The first mint continues not to work, possibly because the commission and ticket are coded to be awarded to an existing NFT holder, but no such holder exists for the first mint.

3 - The NFT size is good, and the 'View Book' button also looks good.

4 - The badges look good, but they are currently arranged with 5 in the top row and 3 in the bottom row. If possible, please make it 4 on the top row and 4 on the bottom row.

execution.observed_behavior: Client reports that the displayed eight-badge catalog looks good; the requested row arrangement change belongs to the separate badge-layout Requirement.
